title.narrative: SUPPORT TO CAPACITY DEVELOPMENT OF THE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMISSION OF SIERRA LEONE TO DELIVER ON ITS MANDATE

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to improve the capacity of the Human Rights Commission and its decentralized human rights structures to address human rights challenges and foster respect for fundamental human rights in Sierra Leone. It will address emerging human rights issues, including migration and human trafficking, and support the development of a national action plan on Business and Human Rights. It has two broad output areas: (i) Staff and Institutional capacity of the HRCSL strengthened to effectively deliver a gender responsive human rights promotion and protection mandate; and (ii) strengthened capacity of HRCSL regional offices and decentralised structures to carry out human rights outreach and increased citizens' knowledge of human rights and capacity to demand government accountability for human rights commitments. The project is co-funded by UNDP.
